snippet.title: I Modded Pokemon Emerald So Everything Is BACKWARDS!
snippet.description:
I made a romhack of Pokemon Emerald where you start in the Hall of Fame and then have to play through the entire game in reverse order, slowly losing everything you started with! 
This is a release trailer to showcase all the features of the mod, and maybe even some secrets...

My discord server: https://discord.gg/yQjhykr9yU
Patches for all my public mods: https://tinyurl.com/viperiomods
ChaoticMeatball's video: https://youtu.be/wkEBC2vx4Qk
Nuzlocke Joe's original FireRed backwards video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mmIMn7lI3_w
